notes: Governing documents: HRG18 (paid parental leave and teaching release for faculty), HRG11 (family and medical leave), HRG07 (pregnancy and childbirth absence), HR16 (leave without salary), AC23 and its 2017-18 Administrative Guidelines (tenure clock). The P&T FAQ and the Faculty Handbook are summaries ('not intended to be definitive on policy matters'); the only provision found solely in a summary is the long-term disability plan (c22, summary_only).

Calendar: the Faculty Handbook states 'Classes meet on a semester calendar' without a length; calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order. Note that R3b/R15b's Penn State example uses 17 weeks per semester (the 2018 coding), which comes before the kind default in R8's order.

Split judgment: HR16 lists three purposes; the first ('For sickness, maternity (see HRG07), or family care (see HRG11)') is coded c17 (not general-purpose), the formal-study and 'any other reason' purposes c18 (general_purpose, U1). HRG11 itself calls the HR16 sickness limb 'additional periods of sick leave without pay'.

HRG11 'Employee's Own Serious Health Condition' restates the FMLA leave ('as described in the law') and points to HR16 for additional time; it is coded within the FMLA component c9 (own serious health condition, birth parent) and HR16 c17, not as a separate component. HRG11 intermittent/reduced-schedule leave is part of the FMLA leave (c9).

Not components: HR17 sabbatical leave, HR18 graduate study leave and HR19 military leave (handbook) cannot be used for a birth; HR48 child care centres and the Employee Assistance Program are services, not leave.

Tenure clock c20: AC23's list ends 'or any similar situation', so it is coded general_purpose under U1 (non-exhaustive list); the listed purposes are all health, family or birth/adoption, so this is a close call (reported).

Faculty sick leave: the handbook says 'there is no formal vacation or sick leave policy for faculty', so the own-accrual components (c13, c15) and HRG18's 'for those faculty who accrue' clause are unlikely to apply to an academic-year tenure-stream member; recorded as written.

Chain, birth parent: HRG18 paid leave 6 (at least) inside the birth-semester teaching release [semester] (c1 within c4) | alternatives: paid leave 6 -> following-semester release [semester] (c5, discretionary) | unpaid leave for the semester starting with the paid leave (c6 concurrent_with c1; c1 granted whichever option, so not linked to c6, R15b); HRG11 child care leave up to the child's first birthday starts with the paid leave (c8 concurrent_with c1), FMLA 12 workweeks alongside (c9 concurrent_with c1, c8); a general personal leave may follow (c18 consecutive_after c8). HRG07 leave (c14, own sick leave c15 within it) and HR16 sickness leave (c17) are unlinked.

Chain, non-birth parent: HRG18 partner leave 2 (at least) within three months of the birth (c2, unplaced window); HRG11 child care leave up to the child's first birthday (c8) with FMLA 12 workweeks alongside (c9); family illness leave 12 weeks to care for the partner (c10) unlinked.

Leave limits: HRG11's three-month limit on family-illness leave (counting prior unpaid child-care time) and HR16's 24-month limit on a personal leave following child care leave are recorded in the duration notes of c10 and c18, not as leave_limits entries, because an entry would also cap the child care leave (schema §1, Yale exception).
